description: Land Acquisition - Kaluwana, Tumpane D/S Division, Kandy District - Gunadaha, Tumpane D/S Division, Kandy District - Pubbiliya, Tumpane, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically describing multiple parcels of land being acquired by the government for public purposes. It includes detailed descriptions of land lots, their locations, names, types (land, road, footpath, etc.), claimants, and extents. The content falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" including "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined for Type 4 classification.
